actions.description: Create a new candidate application for a job opening in the BambooHR ATS.
actions.name: create-applicant

firstName.description: The first name of the candidate. Example: "John"

lastName.description: The last name of the candidate. Example: "Doe"

jobId.description: The id of the job opening for the candidate application. Example: 22

email.description: The email address of the candidate. Must be a valid email address.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the candidate.

source.description: The source of the candidate application, e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.

address.description: The street address of the candidate.

state.description: The state or province of the candidate. Accepts state name, abbreviation, or ISO code.

zip.description: The zip code or postal code of the candidate.

country.description: The country of the candidate. Accepts country name or ISO code.

linkedinUrl.description: The LinkedIn profile URL of the candidate.

dateAvailable.description: The available start date of the candidate. Format: Y-m-d (e.g. 2024-06-01).

desiredSalary.description: The desired salary of the candidate.

referredBy.description: The person or entity that referred the candidate.

websiteUrl.description: The personal website, blog, or online portfolio of the candidate.

highestEducation.description: The highest completed education level of the candidate.

collegeName.description: The college or university of the candidate.

references.description: A list of references supplied by the candidate.

actions.description: Create a performance goal for an employee in BambooHR.
actions.name: create-employee-goal

employeeId.description: The employee ID with whom the goal is associated. Example: 123

description.description: A detailed description of the goal

dueDate.description: The due date for the goal in YYYY-MM-DD format

percentComplete.description: Initial percentage of completion for a simple goal (0-100). Defaults to 0 if omitted. Ignored when milestones is provided.

completionDate.description: The date when the goal was completed in YYYY-MM-DD format. Only valid when percentComplete is 100.

sharedWithEmployeeIds.description: List of employee IDs with whom the goal is shared. Must include the employee ID of the goal owner.

alignsWithOptionId.description: ID of the option this goal aligns with

milestones.description: Optional. Provide a non-empty array of milestone objects to create a milestone-based goal. Omit this field to create a simple goal.

actions.description: Create an employee table row in BambooHR.
actions.name: create-employee-table-row

table.description: The API name of the table to add a row to. Example: "jobInfo"

fields.description: Dictionary of table field names and values for the new row.

actions.description: Create a training record for an employee in BambooHR.
actions.name: create-employee-training

employeeId.description: Employee ID. Example: "4"

completed.description: Completion date in yyyy-mm-dd format. Example: "2026-05-29"

hours.description: Number of hours for the training.

notes.description: Optional notes about the training record.

cost.description: Optional cost for the training record.

amount.description: Monetary amount as a decimal string (e.g. "100.00").

actions.description: Create an employee in BambooHR
actions.name: create-employee

hireDate.description: Hire date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

actions.description: Create a time off request in BambooHR.
actions.name: create-time-off-request

employeeId.description: The ID of the employee to create the time off request for. Example: 123

status.description: The initial status of the request.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-04-15

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be on or after the start date. Example: 2026-04-18

timeOffTypeId.description: The ID of the time off type for this request. Example: 1

amount.description: Total hours or days requested. Ignored when dates is provided.

previousRequest.description: The ID of a previous time off request to supersede.

notes.description: Optional notes from the employee or manager.

dates.description: Optional per-day breakdown mapping YYYY-MM-DD to amount.

actions.description: Create a webhook subscription in BambooHR.
actions.name: create-webhook

name.description: The name of the webhook. Example: "Employee Updates"

monitorFields.description: A list of fields to monitor. Required when events includes employee.updated or employee_with_fields.updated, or when events is omitted.

postFields.description: An object map of field ID or alias to the external name used in the webhook payload. Example: {"firstName": "First Name"}

url.description: The URL the webhook should send data to. Must begin with https://. Example: "https://example.com/webhook"

format.description: The payload format the webhook uses.

includeCompanyDomain.description: If set to true, the company domain will be added to the webhook request header.

events.description: Events that trigger this webhook. Defaults to employee_with_fields events if not specified.

title.description: A label for the report. Included in the response and used as the file name for downloaded reports.

fields.description: Array of field IDs to include as columns in the report. Maximum of 400 fields.

onlyCurrent.description: Whether to restrict historical fields to current values only. Defaults to true.

value.description: ISO 8601 date-time to filter employees by last-modified date. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

includeNull.description: Whether to include employees with no last-changed date.

employeeIds.description: Restrict results to specific employee IDs.

filterDuplicates.description: Whether to apply standard duplicate row filtering. Defaults to enabled.

employeeId.description: The employee ID. Example: "123"

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. When omitted, only the employee id is returned.

actions.description: Retrieve the time off balance for an employee in BambooHR.
actions.name: get-time-off-balance

employeeId.description: The ID of the employee to get time off balances for. Example: "123"

startDate.description: The start date for the balance calculation window, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The date to calculate the time off balance as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to company today if not provided.

precision.description: Number of decimal places for balance and usedYearToDate values. Minimum 0, maximum 4. Defaults to 2.

actions.name: list-applicants

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number). Omit for the first page.

job_id.description: A Job ID to limit results to.

application_status_id.description: One or more application status IDs to filter by, comma-separated (e.g. "1,2,3").

application_status.description: One or more application status group codes to filter by, comma-separated (e.g. "NEW,ACTIVE"). Allowed values: ALL, ALL_ACTIVE, NEW, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, HIRED.

job_status_groups.description: One or more position status groups to filter by, comma-separated (e.g. "Draft,Open"). Allowed values: ALL, DRAFT_AND_OPEN, Open, Filled, Draft, Deleted, On Hold, Canceled.

search_string.description: A general search criteria by which to find applications.

sort_by.description: A specific field to sort the results by. Allowed values: first_name, job_title, rating, phone, status, last_updated, created_date.

sort_order.description: Order by which to sort results. Allowed values: ASC, DESC.

new_since.description: Only return applications submitted after this UTC timestamp. Format: Y-m-d H:i:s (e.g. "2024-01-01 13:00:00").
